stops.name: Observatorio de Sierra Nevada
stops.detail: Inside this park is the Sierra Nevada Observatory and the southernmost ski resort in Europe, known for its mild temperatures and abundant hours of sunshine.

stops.name: estación de esquí de Sierra Nevada
stops.detail: Within the park different activities can be practiced, highlighting those of the Sierra Nevada ski resort, such as skiing or snowboarding.

days.title: Botanical Heritage and Lagoons
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: laguna del Padul
stops.detail: Some areas located inside the natural park, such as the Padul lagoon, enjoy the same protection as the national park area.

stops.name: Jardín Botánico de la Cortijuela
stops.detail: On the edge of the park is the Cortijuela Botanical Garden, where the endemic species of Sierra Nevada are studied, preserved, and monitored.

stops.name: Centro Botánico Hoya de Pedraza
stops.detail: Located within the park are: the Cortijuela Botanical Garden, the Hoya de Pedraza Botanical Center, both dependent on the Junta de Andalucía, and the Sierra Nevada Botanical Garden dependent on the University of Granada; in all of them, the endemic species of the Sierra are researched and preserved.
